text: dsh-quick-view 是 DSH 网页客户端的会话导航插件，在会话界面右侧显示可悬浮展开的历史输入导航器。它通过 conversation.session.header.utilities 界面槽注册面板，从当前会话读取用户消息并为每条消息生成简短预览。用户悬停可展开文本列表，点击条目即可滚动到对应消息；当前最后一条输入默认高亮，手动选择后会更新选中标记。它适合在较长的 DSH 对话中快速找回先前提问。需要 DSH web profile 和兼容的 Web 客户端，不需要额外密钥或服务。

dsh-quick-view is a DSH web plugin with a floating navigator for prior user inputs. It lists short previews beside the conversation; hover to expand and click an entry to scroll to that message. The latest input is selected by default. It requires a DSH web profile, with no extra key or service.
想在很长的 DSH 对话里快速回到之前问过的问题。
能不能在会话旁边列出我发过的每条输入？
让网页会话显示一个可以点击的历史提问导航。
我想通过简短预览找到前面某条用户消息并跳过去。
Help me jump back to an earlier question in a long DSH conversation.
Can I browse my previous inputs beside the chat and click one to return?
dsh-quick-view 的功能「历史输入预览」：用户消息会按会话顺序列出，文本内容压缩成最多 80 个字符的单行预览；非文本内容不加入预览。
dsh-quick-view 的功能「悬停展开导航」：右侧默认显示输入对应的短横标记；悬停后展开带文本的面板，指向某行时突出显示该行。
dsh-quick-view 的功能「跳转到历史消息」：点击某条输入的导航行后，插件查找会话滚动区域中的对应消息锚点并调整滚动位置；消息尚未渲染时不执行跳转。
dsh-quick-view 的功能「当前输入标记」：最后一条用户输入默认以选中颜色标记；点击另一条后更新选中状态，便于识别当前定位的消息。
长对话里消息太多了，我想点一下就回到之前的提问。
Show a compact map of my questions so I can revisit one without scrolling through the whole chat.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · dsh-quick-view：A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web client plugin that adds a **floating right-side navigator** to the conversation page. In a long session it is hard to find where you earlier asked something; this plugin lists every user input down the right edge and jumps the transcript to that message on click.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · dsh-quick-view：It is a browser-only (`dsh.client`) bundle — no host service, no tool, no prompt change. It registers into the `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot that the dsh web bundle already declares, so it composes into the shipped UI without any repo change.
@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · Install：Two ways, mirroring other dsh plugins. Both need the dsh CLI on `PATH`.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · 1. From the npm registry (recommended — no clone or build step)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @pengls/dsh-quick-view
```

The published tarball ships the prebuilt `lib/`, so `pnpm` installs it and `dsh` activates its patch layer — no `prepare` script runs.
section: 1. From the npm registry (recommended — no clone or build step)

text:
@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · 2. From GitHub source：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:pengls/dsh-quick-view
```

A git install fetches **sources**, which is fine here: this repo commits its built `lib/`, so a plain `dsh plugin add github:pengls/dsh-quick-view` needs no build step and hits no `allowBuilds` gate. Rebuild `lib/` (`npm run build`) only when you edit `src/`.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · How it works：`cordis.patch.yml` inserts one row mounting this package as a `dsh.client` plugin; `package.json` declares `dsh.client` (`platform: 'web'`), so the host's client-modules node half scans its `./client` export into `window.__DSH_BOOT__`. The browser half (`src/client/index.ts`) registers a list occupant of `conversation.session.header.utilities` via `ctx.slots.inject(...)` — the safe cross-package registration that waits on ui-conversation's slot declaration.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · How it works：`QuickViewPanel.tsx` reads only the framework session kit (`useSession` → `conversation.chat.order`/`nodes`) and builds the list. Clicking an entry uses the semantic anchor `[data-chat-anchor-key]` the chat view stamps, then scrolls its `[data-conversation-scroll]` scrollport — so it works across reflow and load-older pagination. No store, no business layer, no host round trip.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · How it works：The browser half is built as an **out-of-repo closure-factory bundle**: `scripts/build.mjs` (esbuild) externalizes the shell baseline (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client`) and wraps output in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory: (require) => { … } })`.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build                 # emits lib/index.js + lib/client.js
npm run typecheck             # validates src/ against the dsh type sources
```

`tsconfig.json` extends `../../deepseek-harness/tsconfig.base.client.json` so `@deepseek-ai/*` resolves to real type sources; point `extends` at your dsh checkout if it lives elsewhere. The build itself uses esbuild and does not need the checkout.

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · Releasing a new version：Both install paths above resolve the same package, so every release means bumping, pushing, and publishing in one sweep:

@pengls/dsh-quick-view README · 2. Rebuild and commit lib/ (kept in git so GitHub installs need no build)：npm run build
git add -A
git commit -m "Release v<version>"
git push origin main

text: @pengls/dsh-quick-view README · Model Experience：This plugin adds no host prompt section, no tool schema, and no model-visible input. Its only effect is a client-side floating control; it does not change the session log or the model context.
